newsitem.title: NORWAY: Saga restarts oil output at N.Sea Snorre.
newsitem.headline: Saga restarts oil output at N.Sea Snorre.

text.p: Saga Petroleum ASA said on Friday it had restarted oil production at the North Sea Snorre field after a five-day unscheduled shutdown.
"We started oil production at 5 p.m. (1500 GMT). We should reach peak output of 200,000 barrels per day early tomorrow (Saturday)," Saga spokesman Bjoern Schibevaag told Reuters.
"Production drilling will start earliest on Monday."
Output at the development was shut in late on Sunday when a short circuit in the main power system caused a black out.
The main system was restarted on Tuesday, but the platform's auxilliary generators developed a malfunction. Safety regulations require that both systems function before production can restart.
Oil from Snorre is piped to the Statfjord development for final processing, storage and loading into dedicated shuttle tankers.
